items.description: Finding Annie is a short horror game that based around a girl named Annie who is lost in the deserted location and hiding from scary creatures. As a player you need to find Annie in this deserted lonely world that has teleportation that can be triggered to teleport Annie to a new location that you will have to look again until you find Annie to ensure and assure her safety.Using WASD and Arrow keys to move the player, keycode Space for jump and keycode E to open door in the search for Annie. items.description: Mind WithinCrafted by Helix Interactive StudiosMind Within is a psychological adventure game that takes you deep into the human mind—where imagination, memory, and trauma intertwine. Navigate surreal dreamscapes, solve layered puzzles, and face haunting manifestations of the subconscious as you uncover a deeply personal story of resilience and recovery.You play as a young protagonist trapped within their own psyche, piecing together forgotten moments and confronting fears through exploration, stealth mechanics, and emotional storytelling. Each level represents a different layer of the mind, blending stylized visuals with dynamic gameplay that challenges both logic and emotion.But Mind Within isn’t just about escape—it’s about understanding.🔍 Key FeaturesNarrative-Driven Gameplay: Dive into a rich psychological story told through symbolic environments and immersive voice acting.Atmospheric Exploration: Every level is a handcrafted mental landscape filled with hidden meanings and secrets.Dynamic Puzzle Design: Solve intuitive and story-integrated puzzles that evolve with your character's journey.Stealth and Survival: Avoid manifestations of fear in tense sequences where your choices matter.Original Soundtrack: A haunting and emotional score that adapts with the narrative.👾 Who We AreMind Within is developed by Helix Interactive Studios, an indie team passionate about combining storytelling with meaningful gameplay. We also teach game development—follow us for behind-the-scenes tutorials, breakdowns, and devlogs.Stream. Develop. Play. items.description: An abandoned planet for millennia. You, a humanoid from the future, have a mission: dig, find relics, and solve puzzles.Dig:Unearth strange objects and artifacts left by humans. Each excavation is an opportunity to discover something useful or bizarre.Find Relics:Discover items that seem to have come out of a science fiction movie, accompanied by curious descriptions. Why is a gas mask called a "flatulence protection device"?Solve Puzzles:Face challenges that require reasoning and creativity. Each solved puzzle brings more fun and new relics. You don't need to be an archaeologist to unravel the mysteries!Turn into Fuel:Convert these strange objects into fuel for your ship and prepare to leave this forgotten planet.Dig, discover, solve puzzles, and laugh at the oddities of the past. An adventure where the curiosities of the past become the fuel of your future!
